d.ko: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.
d.en: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.
d.zh: 与好友一起操作二战高射炮。发现来袭的轰炸机、报告距离、设定引信，并亲手装填每一发炮弹。Flak Simulator 是一款第一人称合作模拟游戏，每一次精准射击都离不开整个炮组的配合。
